moments.title: One rupee doubled every day for 30 days — the magic of compounding
moments.summary: The facilitator sets up the doubling exercise and names it the magic of compounding, then walks the class through the arithmetic: 1 rupee on day 1, 16 rupees by day 5, 512 by day 10 and over 16,000 by day 15.
moments.evidence: And that's what we call as the magic of compounding.
